{npc:Ysbasra}, in a tent in Cormaya, is looking for her brother, who was kidnapped and sold to the scientist **Doctor Marrow**, who carries out abominable experiments on humans on the island of {wiki:Ingol|Ingol}. Go down through his laboratory floor by floor, helping the assistants and the victims (9 missions, several of them lever-based team tasks), and at the end face {creature:Doctor Marrow} and his creation, {creature:The Monster}. The reward is the **Mutated Abomination** mount and the achievement **Strangest Thing**.
A scientist of dubious reputation is carrying out abominable experiments on human beings. Will you put an end to this madness?
Mission **Hungry New World** of the {wiki:Krailos Quest} completed (access to the Krailos depot, where {npc:Kaya} is, needed in mission 7).

Hawkhurst's boat between Cormaya and Ingol
After accepting {npc:Ysbasra}'s mission, {npc:Hawkhurst} takes you to Ingol ({key:passage}).
Floors of Doctor Marrow's laboratory (Deeper Ingol)
Mission by mission: {npc:Vasko}, {npc:Avan}, {npc:Aletta}, {npc:Ivora} and {npc:Geoffray} open the next doors for you.
When you hand in the Anti-Mutagen mission to {npc:Geoffray}: the door south-west of him opens.
Lever in the reward room, after killing {creature:The Monster} for the first time.
The lever missions (Dangerous Apparatus, Mutagens, Collection Container and Hazard Golem) have a **4-hour cooldown**; the final boss has **20 hours**.
Bring the {item:Mushroom Pie}, the 10 {item:Bug Meat} and the {item:Spoon} on your very first trip: Ingol is far away and can only be reached by boat from Cormaya.

Ingol is full of strong creatures ({creature:Rhindeer|Rhindeers}, {creature:Harpy|Harpies}, {creature:Carnivostrich|Carnivostriches}, {creature:Crape Man|Crape Men}, {creature:Boar Man|Boar Men} and {creature:Liodile|Liodiles}) on every floor. Bring enough potions.

{npc:Avan} buys the products of the island's creatures ({item:Rhindeer Antlers}, {item:Harpy Feathers}, {item:Carnivostrich Feather}, {item:Boar Man Hoof}, {item:Crab Man Claws} and {item:Liodile Fang}).
The laboratory floors are stacked: 1st floor z=8 ({npc:Vasko}), 2nd z=9 ({npc:Avan}), 3rd z=10 ({npc:Aletta}), 4th z=11 ({npc:Ivora}, in the caves) and 5th z=12 ({npc:Geoffray}).
The quest starts in a hidden tent on Cormaya, the island south of Edron. Ysbasra tells you the story and arranges the trip with a smuggler, Hawkhurst, who takes you to the island of Ingol.
Go to the **Edron** harbour and talk to {npc:Captain Seahorse}: {key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes} (20 gp). You disembark at Cormaya's **north** harbour, next to {npc:Pemaret}.
On Cormaya, go to the tent at the marked spot ({coord:33318,32008,7}) and step into the **teleport** next to it. You appear inside {npc:Ysbasra}'s tent.

Say {key:hi}, then {key:passage} and answer {key:yes}. If you want the full story, first ask about {key:trouble}, {key:purposes}, {key:scientist}, {key:reputation} and {key:disregard}. She arranges the trip with a smuggler from Cormaya and you gain access to Ingol.
The wiki does not describe the way out of the tent: leave the same way you came in and, once back on Cormaya, head to the island's **north-east** coast ({coord:33356,31985,7}).

On the **north-east** coast of Cormaya is Captain {npc:Hawkhurst}. Say {key:hi} and ask him for a {key:passage} to Ingol (if he asks for confirmation, answer {key:yes}). He only takes you after you have accepted Ysbasra's mission. You disembark at the Ingol pier ({coord:33709,32602,6}), **west** of the laboratory.
How to leave Ingol (whenever you need to)

To go back, go up from the laboratory to the surface and walk **west** to the pier where you arrived: {npc:Hawkhurst} is also on Ingol ({coord:33709,32602,6}) and takes you back to Cormaya (ask him for the trip the same way, with {key:hi} and {key:passage}). On Cormaya, {npc:Pemaret} at the north harbour ({coord:33287,31956,6}) takes you to Edron for 20 gp ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}).
The wiki does not transcribe the return conversation with Hawkhurst; if {key:passage} does not work, try {key:cormaya}.
Doctor Marrow's laboratory is in the centre of the island and spreads over 5 underground floors.
From the Ingol pier, walk **east** to the laboratory building ({coord:33800,32574,7}) and go down the stairs. On the 1st floor (z=8) you find {npc:Vasko}.

Along the way there are {creature:Rhindeer|Rhindeers}, {creature:Harpy|Harpies}, {creature:Carnivostrich|Carnivostriches}, {creature:Crape Man|Crape Men}, {creature:Boar Man|Boar Men} and {creature:Liodile|Liodiles}: all high-level creatures.
Say {key:hi} and {key:mission}. Vasko is hungry: he wants 10 {item:Bug Meat} and a {item:Mushroom Pie} to open the door for you.
With the {item:Mushroom Pie} and the 10 {item:Bug Meat} in your inventory, say {key:mission} again. You gain access to the room directly **south** of Vasko.
Access to the Dangerous Apparatus task room.
First lever task: up to 5 players, 15 minutes to charge the Strange Machine. 4-hour cooldown.

In the room **south** of {npc:Vasko}, pull the lever (up to 5 players can enter together). You have **15 minutes** to charge the {creature:Strange Machine (Creature)|Strange Machine} by repositioning the {creature:Dangerous Apparatus}.

Over time a rising number appears next to each player's name. If it reaches **40**, you are kicked out of the room. To lower it, step on the {item:Decharger}, a little to the **south-west** in the room.
Watch your number throughout the task: reaching 40 removes you from the room.

The machine only charges when it is hit by the attacks of the {creature:Positive Spark}. As the Positive Spark does not leave the **north-east** area of the room, you have to align the devices ({creature:Dangerous Apparatus}) so that the beams leave the north-east device and travel, device by device, all the way to the machine.

To rotate a device, stand next to it with the {creature:Negative Spark} close to you: it is its attack that ends up putting the device in the right position. Use the image as the recommended layout and start from the **end** (devices next to the Strange Machine room) towards the **start** (Positive Spark area).

When everything is aligned, one player goes to the **north-east** area of the room so that the {creature:Positive Spark} attacks the first device and creates the beams. After a few beams the team reaches the goal and is teleported out of the room.
Mission complete; head to the floor below.
Go down to the 2nd floor of the laboratory (z=9) and talk to {npc:Avan}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}. He wants you to kill **100** {creature:Rhindeer|Rhindeers}.
Kill 100 {creature:Rhindeer|Rhindeers} around Ingol. The kills you made **before** accepting the mission also count.
For a kill to count in the quest log you have to be the one who dealt the **most damage**, or be in a party with shared experience active with whoever dealt the most damage.
Also given by Avan. Up to 5 players, but it is easily done solo. You have 10 minutes.
On {npc:Avan}'s floor (z=9), enter the room to the **south** and go through the teleport. You have **10 minutes** before you are kicked out.

The goal is to have at least **11 Mutagens of the same colour**. Each Mutagen starts in a random colour. Each lever fires a beam that changes the colour of **all** the Mutagens in that row, always in this order:

Pick a target colour, for example **Black**. Use the levers of the rows that have **no** black Mutagen. Repeat until you have 11 of the same. Also note the colour before yours (for Black it is **Red**): sometimes it pays to use a lever and lose 1 black if that turns 2 reds into blacks. You have to stand **in front** of a lever to pull it, so you will keep walking from one to the other.
With the 11 matching Mutagens, use the **lone lever to the north** to complete the task.
If you get all **16** Mutagens in the same colour before pulling the north lever, you earn the achievement **Mutagenius**.
Mission complete (and, optionally, the Mutagenius achievement).
Aletta, on the 3rd floor, wants the research notes Doctor Marrow hides from her: notes copied from 3 boards, a book with transcripts and some records thrown in the rubbish.
Go down to the 3rd floor of the laboratory (z=10) and talk to {npc:Aletta}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}.
You need 3 {item:Blank Paper|Blank Papers}. There is one on the 1st floor, one on the 2nd and one on the 3rd floor of the laboratory, at the marked spots.
Take the {item:Feather and Inkwell} from the desk right next to {npc:Aletta}.

Go out to the caves to the **north** on this same floor and visit the 3 small rooms marked on the map. In each one, stand in front of the note board and use the {item:Feather and Inkwell} on a {item:Blank Paper}: you receive some {item:Copied Research Notes}.
Go to the marked tree stump and take the {item:Book with Transcripts} from it.
In the caves to the **south**, look for the marked rubbish heap and take the research records from it.
Go back to {npc:Aletta} with the 3 copied notes, the book and the records and say {key:hi}, {key:mission}.
Aletta lets you through the next door.
Lever task for up to 5 players. Because of the randomness, going with at least 2 is strongly recommended.
Enter and get to know the room

Go through the door {npc:Aletta} opened for you, pull the task lever and enter (the wiki does not give the exact position of this room or of the lever). In the room there are 3 units: {creature:Blue Collector Unit|Blue} (left), {creature:Green Collector Unit|Green} (middle) and {creature:Red Collector Unit|Red} (right). The goal is to bring the counters of all three to **50** at more or less the same time.

If the counters are in **different tens** (for example two between 10 and 20 and one between 20 and 30), the counter of {creature:The Collection Container} in the centre of the room goes up. The tens also show on the tubes behind the units ({creature:Blue Tube|Blue}, {creature:Green Tube|Green} and {creature:Red Tube|Red}).
If the Collection Container's counter reaches **100**, you fail the task.
The counters go up on their own, but at different speeds, and one of them is much faster than the others. Identify the **slowest** unit: that is the one you will focus on.

To raise a unit by hand, push a container of the same colour ({creature:Blue Container|Blue}, {creature:Green Container|Green} or {creature:Red Container|Red}) until it is next to it. There are two sources of containers: one of each colour appears **south** of the matching unit, and the {creature:Lab Assistant|Lab Assistants} turn into a container of a random colour when you kill them.

Containers move very slowly: kill the Lab Assistants **next to** the unit with the lowest counter. Also use the containers that appear on their own, even if they seem far away, because the Lab Assistants may not give the colour you need.
When all three units reach 50, an orange message appears in the room: *"YOU MANAGED TO POWER THE DOORS AND MAKE THEM OPERATIONABLE."* The task is done.
Ivora was transformed against her will by Doctor Marrow and wants her family to know. This mission makes you go to Krailos and back.
{npc:Ivora} is not in the building but in the caves of the 4th floor (z=11). Leave by the **east** exit and walk **north**, along the mountain, until you find her hut.
Say {key:hi} and {key:mission}. Ivora gives you a {item:Letter (Ingol)|Letter} for her sister, {npc:Kaya}. She thinks Kaya lives in Port Hope, but she is now on Krailos.

Leave Ingol with {npc:Hawkhurst} (west pier, {coord:33709,32602,6}) to Cormaya and from there with {npc:Pemaret} to Edron ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}). At the Edron harbour talk to {npc:Captain Seahorse}: {key:hi}, {key:krailos}, {key:yes} (100 gp). You arrive at {npc:Captain Pelagia}'s boat, off Krailos; she warns that, because of the reefs, she cannot get any closer to the coast and that **you have to swim** to land. Then walk **east** across the steppe to the village (Krailos Village), where {npc:Larek}'s tent is.
Go down to the Krailos depot
In Krailos Village enter {npc:Larek}'s tent and use the {item:Grille|grille} to go down to the depot (you need the Hungry New World mission of the {wiki:Krailos Quest}). Down there is {npc:Kaya}.

Go up from the depot to {npc:Larek}'s tent the same way, swim back to {npc:Captain Pelagia}'s boat ({coord:33492,31710,6}) and ask her for the trip to Edron ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}; 100 gp). In Edron, {npc:Captain Seahorse} to Cormaya ({key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes}; 20 gp) and, on the north-east coast of Cormaya ({coord:33356,31985,7}), {npc:Hawkhurst} to Ingol ({key:hi}, {key:passage}). Go down through the laboratory again to the caves of the 4th floor (z=11), where {npc:Ivora} is.
Go back to {npc:Ivora}'s hut and say {key:hi}, {key:mission} to report that you delivered the letter. She had promised to open the door for you in return.
The wiki does not transcribe this return conversation; {key:mission} is the word used with all the laboratory NPCs.
Ivora opens the next door for you.
Lever task for 2 to 5 players (**at least 2 are required**). Communication within the team is essential.

Go through the door {npc:Ivora} opened for you and enter the task via the lever (the wiki does not give the exact position of this room). Inside, kill the {creature:Guardian Golem} that appears in the **north-west** of the room. Its corpse becomes {item:Some Golem Parts}.
Throw the {item:Some Golem Parts} into the open trapdoor **south** of the counter with the levers. On the **third** time a {creature:Hazard Golem} appears in the sulphur area.
You will need **at least 4 golems** to finish: the golem loses a lot of health destroying the Ice Barricades. Keep killing Guardian Golems and throwing in the parts.

One player stays at the counter levers. The **north** lever makes the golem walk faster (important, because it takes constant damage in the sulphur area). The other three protect it from the obstacles. Only **one lever can be active at a time**, so you have to switch them on and off constantly.
Lever in front of the {item:Steel Shield}
Lever in front of the {item:Bucket of Water}
Lever in front of the {item:Fire Portal} (each barricade is only destroyed once and does not come back)
A player steps on the button off the path, right in front of the blades
One player on the levers; at least one other calling out the obstacles and stepping on the blade buttons. A third player is recommended to easily cover all the buttons (on the inner and outer paths).
Lead the golem to the machine
Guide the {creature:Hazard Golem} to the end of the path. When it reaches the machine, the task is complete.
Mission complete; head to the 5th floor.
Geoffray, on the 5th floor, wants you to cure the 5 victims in the test tubes with 5 Flasks with Anti-Mutagen. Each flask needs 3 ingredients, so you will need 5 of each.
Go down to the 5th floor of the laboratory (z=12) and talk to {npc:Geoffray}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}.

Use the {item:Hydra Corms} scattered around the Ingol caves to get {item:Fresh Hydra Herbs}. You need 5. On the 5th floor there is only one ({coord:33724,32489,12}); on the 4th floor (z=11) there are several, at the spots on the map.
Hydra Corms (the only one on the 5th floor)
The {item:Empty Flask|Empty Flasks} come from the laboratory's {item:Pile of Ominous Flasks|Piles of Ominous Flasks}. There is one per floor; they all share the same **5-minute** cooldown.
Go up to the floor above Geoffray (z=11) and use an {item:Empty Flask} on the container furthest **south** in the middle of the room to get {item:Nutrient Solution}.
The flask does not stay full for long. If the liquid disappears, you are left with the empty flask and can fill it again.
Take an {item:Egg Cracker} from the crate **north-east** of Geoffray.

Look for {item:Some Eggs} around the caves (there are several on this floor, at the spots on the map). Use the {item:Egg Cracker} on an egg to turn it into {item:Broken Eggs} and then use the {item:Spoon} on the broken eggs to collect the {item:Bottled Yolk}.
The yolk disappears shortly after you collect it: run straight to the cauldron.

Use the ingredients on the {item:Suspicious Cauldron} next to Geoffray, **in this order**: 1) {item:Nutrient Solution}, 2) {item:Bottled Yolk}, 3) {item:Fresh Hydra Herbs}. You receive a {item:Flask with Anti-Mutagen}. Repeat 4 more times until you have 5 flasks.

According to Geoffray, the Nutrient Solution goes into the cauldron first, then you add the yolk and, finally, the herbs. As the yolk disappears quickly, you should already have the {item:Fresh Hydra Herbs} with you when you collect it.

Use a {item:Flask with Anti-Mutagen} on each of the 5 preservation jars: one on the shelf directly **north** of Geoffray, two in the **north-east** corner of that same room and another two in the **north-east** room.
Jars 2 and 3 (north-east corner of the room)
Go back to {npc:Geoffray} and say {key:mission}. You gain access to the door **south-west** of him: the boss room.
Access to the final boss room.
11. Final battle: Doctor Marrow and The Monster
Up to 5 players, 20-hour cooldown. The fight has two phases: first Doctor Marrow and then his creation, The Monster.

{creature:Doctor Marrow} has extremely strong attacks that can deal {wiki:Critical Hits|critical hits} of up to about **10,000** damage, killing even high-level players in one go. He can also make you {wiki:Drunk|Drunk}, {wiki:Rooted|Rooted} and {wiki:Feared|Feared}. Everyone should go in with a {item:Might Ring} and a {item:Sacred Tree Amulet}; mages should have {spell:Magic Shield} on at least until the team is in position.
Against Doctor Marrow use **Earth** protection equipment; against The Monster, **Energy** protection.
Go through the door **south-west** of {npc:Geoffray} and pull the lever. Right at the start everyone may become Feared, Rooted or Drunk.

Feared: protect yourself and the team with {item:Magic Wall Rune|Magic Walls}. Rooted (the worst): be ready to withstand the boss for a few seconds. Drunk: walk carefully so you do not leave the boss room.

There are two popular ways to do this phase. **A)** The blocker uses {spell:Challenge} and stays in a corner while the shooters kill the four {creature:Antenna|Antennas}; then the blocker walks back and forth in the **upper** part of the room, using Challenge whenever possible so the boss does not switch targets, and the shooters stay further **south** attacking. **B)** The blocker uses Challenge quickly, takes the boss to a corner and uses a field bomb (e.g. {item:Fire Bomb Rune}) under their own feet, so they do not run away if they become Feared; the shooters first kill the four Antennas and then attack the boss from a distance.
The {creature:Antenna|Antennas} (10,000 HP each) **heal** the boss: kill them first. Shooters should keep their distance because of the strong Earth area attack.
When Doctor Marrow reaches about **60%** health, he flees and releases {creature:The Monster}.

The Monster starts **invulnerable**, with a counter of **20** next to its name. Destroy the {creature:Alchemistical Container|Alchemistical Containers} in the room: each one leaves a small puddle in front of it. Make The Monster walk over the puddle to lower the counter by 1. The lower the counter, the weaker the boss becomes. You can use {item:Magic Wall Rune|Magic Walls} to guide it, but you have to place them at the right moment because it breaks them quickly.
The Monster applies {wiki:Hexed|Lesser Hexed} to the blocker.

The counter slowly goes back up, so keep moving around the room dealing damage and repeating the puddle mechanic. When both health and counter are low, focus everything on the boss. It is common to concentrate on damage when the counter is below **7**, but it depends on the number of players and the team's damage.

After killing {creature:The Monster} for the **first** time, go back to {npc:Geoffray}'s floor (the wiki does not describe the way out of the boss room: leave through the door south-west of Geoffray that you came in by), enter the other room on that same floor, **south** of Geoffray, and pull the lever. You receive the **Mutated Abomination** mount and the achievement **Strangest Thing**.
Mutated Abomination mount + Strangest Thing achievement.

Go up the 5 floors of the laboratory to the surface the way you came down and walk **west** to {npc:Hawkhurst}'s pier ({coord:33709,32602,6}). He takes you back to Cormaya (the wiki does not transcribe this conversation: try {key:hi} and {key:passage}, or {key:cormaya}); you disembark on the north-east coast of Cormaya ({coord:33356,31985,7}). From there go to the north harbour, where {npc:Pemaret} ({coord:33287,31956,6}) takes you to Edron for 20 gp ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}).
The lever tasks (Dangerous Apparatus, Mutagens, Collection Container and Hazard Golem) have a 4-hour cooldown; the boss has a 20-hour cooldown and can be repeated for more loot.
After the quest, if you go back to {npc:Ysbasra}'s tent on Cormaya, you find an abandoned version of the tent with notes revealing that she was working undercover for the Shiron'Fal.
